mechanism: Baclofen can potentiate aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, and may enhance neuromuscular blockade effects; gentamicin requires renal clearance which may be affected by baclofen-induced renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, avoid high-dose baclofen, and consider therapeutic drug monitoring of gentamicin levels during concurrent use.
